title: The Complexity of ReLU Network Synthesis from a Parameter Multiset
abstract: arXiv:2611.04074v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We ask how hard it is to build a ReLU network when its parameter values are given in advance. An instance supplies an appropriate encoding of a target behavior, a multiset of rational numbers, and a bound on the number of neurons (output included). The question is whether one can choose the graph of a ReLU network within the bound, and place the numbers on its edges and biases so that it meets the target. This separates the numbers from the architecture. Matching two labeled examples exactly is already $\mathsf{NP}$-complete, so we ask what changes when the target must hold on every input or on average. Agreeing with a Boolean circuit on every Boolean input is $\Sigma_2^{\mathsf P}$-complete, already for four neurons. Agreeing with a given ReLU network on every real input lies in $\mathsf{DP}$ for every fixed neuron bound and is $\mathsf{DP}$-complete for three neurons. translated_title: 基于参数多重集的ReLU网络合成复杂性
translated_abstract: 我们探讨当参数值预先给定时，构建一个ReLU网络有多困难。一个实例提供了目标行为的适当编码、一个有理数多重集，以及神经元数量（包括输出神经元）的上界。问题是：能否在该界限内选择ReLU网络的图结构，并将这些数放置到其边和偏置上，使之达到目标。这将数值与网络架构分离开来。精确匹配两个带标签的样例已经是NP完全的，因此我们进一步追问：当目标必须在每个输入上成立或平均意义上成立时，复杂性会发生什么变化。在所有布尔输入上与给定布尔电路一致是Σ₂^P完全的，且仅需四个神经元即可。在所有实数输入上与给定ReLU网络一致，对于每个固定的神经元界限都属于DP类，且在三个神经元时是DP完全的。在单位立方体上以绝对……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文研究了在参数数值与网络架构分离（即参数值预先给定）的条件下合成ReLU网络的计算复杂性，证明精确匹配标注样例为NP完全、在所有布尔输入上匹配布尔电路为Σ₂^P完全（四个神经元即可）、以及在所有实数输入上匹配给定ReLU网络为DP完全（三个神经元时）。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes the computational complexity of synthesizing ReLU networks when parameter values are given in advance (separating numbers from architecture), proving that exactly matching labeled examples is NP-complete, matching a Boolean circuit on all Boolean inputs is Σ₂^P-complete with four neurons, and matching a given ReLU network on all real inputs is DP-complete for three neurons.
